Taffy start page scenes
=======================

Owner: Matterward Labs Private Limited / TaffyGo
Licence: Reserved media, not licensed with the code; see TRADEMARKS.md.
Created: 2026-09-10
Generator: Codex built-in image_gen, image-to-image from the committed
  first-party browsing master (task-scenes/masters/taffy_scene_browsing.png),
  six images per call, one call per part of the day. No other input asset.
Masters: not kept. The 1448 by 1086 generated PNGs were read back one at a
  time, and the twenty-four reviewed here are the whole of what was kept; the
  bytes below are the reviewed and published bytes, and a master would show a
  reviewer nothing they do not.
Shipping: none. These files enter no installer. They are packaged by
  taffy-core/ui/android/tools/scenes/build_scene_pack.py into the
  `start-scenes` delivery-plane artifact and read off the device's disk.
Encoder: cwebp 1.6.0, -q 84 -m 6 -resize 640 480 -metadata none

Twenty-four original editorial gouache scenes commissioned for TaffyGo's start
page, six for each part of the day, in the same painted hand as the two
task scenes recorded beside this file: cream paper ground, muted category
colour, warm terracotta accents. Morning is low warm side light and long
shadows; afternoon flat bright daylight and short shadows; evening amber and
rose with one interior light beginning to matter; night deep indigo with a
single small warm source. Each is a domestic still moment -- a window, a
table, a doorway, a person with a cup or a book -- and no two are the same
scene. Every render was checked for lettering, marks, watermarks and
signatures before it was kept, at full size and at each corner.

These are decorative, inert plates above the wordmark (decision 0145). They
depict no task state, no page, no person's data, no price and no outcome.
Any screen in them is an empty flat shape. No Aster image, mascot,
third-party asset, site screenshot or personal document was copied.

Prompts: the exact built-in generation briefs are kept in the maintainer's
working tree (start-scenes/prompts.md there) and are not published. The
member names follow StartSceneMember in core/ui. Replace one
by generating a new reviewed render with the same brief and encoding it with
the same recipe, then update its two lines here, rebuild the pack, publish
it under a new revision and move the catalog row. Never edit only these
bytes: the pack's digest is pinned in the catalog, and a member changed here
alone is a pack the device will refuse.
